info.title: Node Nexus API
info.description: REST API for managing server nodes, SSH commands, scripts, and remote Docker resources.

get.description:
Liveness probe — checks if the process is running.

No authentication required (for Kubernetes liveness probes).

Readiness probe — checks database connectivity and scheduler state.

No authentication required (for Kubernetes readiness probes).

List nodes with cursor pagination.

Uses common encode_cursor/decode_cursor. The service still exposes
page/size internally for offset fallback; cursor is translated to offset
when the underlying reader is offset-based.
